Gideon, you first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug in this channel. You wrote that both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.

While they were down, the guard wrote trailer numbers on a clipboard. Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03, when the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it. You posted at 11:08 that both lanes were working as of 11:07.
